why: The plus sign moves around the shape: left, top, right, so next it goes to the bottom. Shapes go square, square, circle, circle. Option 3 shows a circle with the plus below it. Option 2 keeps the plus on the right, which is just figure 3 again.
trick: Track the small sign clockwise around the big shape.
